text:
amy.harper: ACME is ready to convert POC -> committed for 50k/mo. They asked for an ops-ready capacity plan: steady throughput, burst handling, pricing example, and security checklist. @sam.kim @kai.chen @vijay.ram please advise.

sam.kim: Got it. Any detailed traffic profile? SLOs? model / quantization?

amy.harper: Sales notes: steady 220 RPS, two daily spikes ~1.1k RPS for ~6 minutes each. Avg response ~75 tokens. SLO: 95% < 300ms TTF, 99% < 600ms overall. Target model: open-13b-quant.

kai.chen: Baseline math: 220 RPS * 75 tokens = 16.5k tokens/s. open-13b-quant on an A100-like node (conservative) ~250 tok/s without cache/batching. With KV cache + continuous batching we often observe 2-3x effective token throughput for chat patterns.

kai.chen: Quick proposal: reserved pool = 36 GPUs, autoscale up to 72 GPUs for spikes. This gives breathing room for two simultaneous spikes and background. Need to run bench with their payload to validate.

vijay.ram: Ops/HA: spread reserved across 2 AZs, reserve quorum per-AZ (min 12 GPUs/AZ). Autoscale policy suggestions:
```
reserved_gpus: 36
max_gpus: 72
scale_up_step: 6
scale_down_step: 3
cooldown_seconds: 600
burst_credit_minutes: 120
preheat_minutes: 15
```
Use 15m preheat to allow KV warmup, and burst credits to absorb instant spikes. Include an emergency manual-scale runbook.

sam.kim: Pricing question: customer wants example invoice showing reserved vs burst billing. Our pattern: reserved = monthly committed GPU-hours at discounted rate; burst = metered pay-as-you-go per GPU-hour. I'll sketch numbers assuming X$/GPU-hour reserved and Y$/GPU-hour burst. Recommend 3-month ramp with telemetry gates (latency, error-rate).

legal.bot: Security checklist items flagged: VPC peering for Private, BYOK/HSM options, SOC2 + HIPAA addendum, audit log retention. We can support VPC Private deployment + BYOK; hosted has managed keys but can add contractual controls. Loop in Compliance for retention SLAs.

amy.harper: Action items: sam -> worked pricing + sample invoice (include reserved 36 GPUs + example 6 spike-hours/month burst); kai -> run open-13b-quant bench with client payload and return perf numbers + recommended reserve; vijay -> confirm AZ placement and draft autoscale + preheat runbook; legal.bot -> start SOC2/HIPAA addendum checklist. I'll send compiled plan to ACME EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: bench started (job-id: 2026-03-22-1202). https://infra/bench/2026-03-22-1202

amy.harper: Thanks all. If bench validates, propose reserving 36 GPUs monthly, burst to 72, 15m preheat, and a 3-month ramp. Will include escalation path and a one-click fallback to smaller model variant if latency spikes. :rocket:
